## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 6 may 2026 - 13 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Troy Rison_, 13 oct 2026, 1/5: "Gets worse with every update. the most recent update took away the ability to see macros for each meal, moving the entire diary to one log and only showing the daily macros. Last update before that added video ads that consistently cause the app to freeze. the update before that caused it to start double-logging things regularly. it has become barely functional."
            2. _Kai Raphael_, 11 oct 2026, 1/5: "app is suddenly really slow"
            3. _Thorsten Mootz_, 30 ago 2026, 1/5: "Neues Update ist ganz schlimm und benutzerunfreundlich. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
<!--/ir-theme-->
